results.query: Recommend something like Parasite that I haven't seen.
results.answer:
Here are a few movie recommendations similar to ***Parasite* (2019)** that you haven't seen yet, ranked by thematic fit and critical reception:

### 1. **A Normal Family (2024)**
* **Genres / Tone:** South Korean Drama / Suspense Thriller
* **TMDB Rating:** 6.9 / 10
* **Why it fits:** Like *Parasite*, this South Korean thriller dives into family dynamics, wealth, and moral hypocrisy. It centers on two brothers—a wealthy, high-powered lawyer and an upright pediatrician—whose families clash when a dark crime involving their teenage children comes to light, turning upscale dinners into tense psychological battlegrounds.

### 2. **No Other Choice (2025)**
* **Genres / Tone:** Dark Drama / Thriller
* **TMDB Rating:** 7.5 / 10
* **Why it fits:** If what resonated with you in *Parasite* was the sharp critique of economic inequality and job desperation, *No Other Choice* tackles similar themes. It follows a laid-off paper mill manager who, humiliated by a cutthroat job market, descends into extreme measures and violence to reclaim his livelihood.

### 3. **I Care a Lot (2021)**
* **Genres / Tone:** Dark Comedy / Crime Thriller
* **TMDB Rating:** 6.6 / 10
* **Why it fits:** Matches *Parasite*'s darkly satirical, "bad people fighting worse people" tension. The story follows a cold, opportunistic legal guardian who cons wealthy elderly clients out of their estates, until she targets someone who turns out to be far more dangerous than she bargained for.

### 4. **The Art of Self-Defense (2019)**
* **Genres / Tone:** Dark Comedy / Thriller
* **TMDB Rating:** 6.6 / 10
* **Why it fits:** Shares *Parasite*’s unique tonal blend of absurd humor and mounting, sinister dread. After being mugged, a mild-mannered man joins a neighborhood karate dojo, only to be drawn into a bizarrely violent underground subculture.

### 5. **The Joneses (2010)**
* **Genres / Tone:** Satirical Drama / Comedy
* **TMDB Rating:** 6.2 / 10
* **Why it fits:** Echoes *Parasite*’s theme of a deceptive household posing as something they're not to infiltrate wealthy suburban life. A seemingly picture-perfect family moves into an affluent neighborhood, hiding the secret behind their enviable lifestyle.

A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.

Thor (2011)
Against his father Odin's will, The Mighty Thor - a powerful but arrogant warrior god - recklessly reignites an ancient war. Thor is cast down to Earth and forced to live among humans as punishment. Once here, Thor learns what it takes to be a true hero when the most dangerous villain of his world sends the darkest forces of Asgard to invade Earth.
Themes: new mexico, superhero, redemption, banishment, based on comic, brother against brother, norse mythology, aftercreditsstinger, marvel cinematic universe (mcu), worlds collide

matches.title: Project Hail Mary
matches.text:
Project Hail Mary (2026)
Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.
Themes: friendship, coma, based on novel or book, bravery, sun, language barrier, space travel, space mission, alien, space
Tone: Tense and urgently suspenseful yet delightfully hopeful, balancing immense stakes with a heartwarming spirit of connection and wonder.
My take: Best movie I’ve seen in theaters in years

matches.title: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
matches.text:
Now You See Me: Now You Don't (2025)
The original Four Horsemen reunite with a new generation of illusionists to take on powerful diamond heiress Veronika Vanderberg, who leads a criminal empire built on money laundering and trafficking. The new and old magicians must overcome their differences to work together on their most ambitious heist yet.
Themes: diamond, antwerp, sequel, diamond heist, misdirection, hidden agenda, sleight of hand, team up, absurd, condescending
Tone: Stylish, slick, and theatrically energetic, brimming with playful bravado, flashy showmanship, and a clever, upbeat intrigue.

Bodies Bodies Bodies (2022)
In an isolated family mansion, a group of rich 20-somethings decides to play Bodies Bodies Bodies, a game where one of them is secretly a "killer" while the rest tries to "escape". Things take a turn for the worse when real bodies start turning up, setting off a paranoid and dangerous chain of events.
Themes: infidelity, love triangle, sword, gun, paranoia, hurricane, rain, satire, mansion, whodunit
Tone: Anxious, paranoid, and sharply satirical, driven by a claustrophobic atmosphere of escalating chaos and hysterical mistrust.

matches.title: Deadpool
matches.text:
Deadpool (2016)
The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, Deadpool hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.
